rv.q: This cast, and this production, really do create a family— that nostalgic, heart-tugging, greeting card, Norman Rockwell sorta family that maybe only ever existed in our heads.
Whether it is finding love, maintaining love, or repairing love, this play is about complex relationships and is a real winner.
Do not miss this truly extraordinary play.
It has the potential to touch every heart in the audience.
MadKap Productions breathes new life into the play by casting real-life couple Bernie Rice and Judy Rossignuolo-Rice as Norman and Ethel Thayer.

cn.t: Critics praise the extraordinary chemistry between real-life couple Bernie Rice and Judy Rossignuolo-Rice in this poignant production, with Rice's curmudgeonly Norman earning particular acclaim in a faithful rendering of Thomson's classic drama about aging.
